'''Tem Riffle''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]]-designer who worked for the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. After he observed a small [[Spacetug/Legends|tug]] transporting a [[YT-1200 medium freighter]] across [[Realspace/Legends|space]], Riffle came up with the idea of designing a small cargo tug that could slot within the forward mandibles of CEC's [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighters]]. CEC's executives supported Riffle's proposal and his idea resulted in the development of the [[Freight-Loading External Rover/Legends|F-LER]], a cargo-handler that saw limited use in conjunction with the YT-1300.
